LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays the current user's recently viewed records in a configurable carousel.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API name
property.description: API name of the object to query.

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Number of records
property.description: Maximum number of records, from 1 to 50.

property.name: fieldApiNames
property.label: Fields
property.description: Comma-separated field API names to display below the record name.
